config_fields.name: openid
config_fields.help: Your 猪八戒 openid (the user identifier returned by the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation), used by zbj.user.getUserBaseInfo.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: appKey (应用证书) of your approved ZOP application (open.zbj.com > 控制台).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: Application secret (应用密钥); signs every call as uppercase hex SHA1 of secret + sorted name/value pairs + secret. Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: accessToken (访问令牌) from the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation of your 猪八戒 account.

adapter.terms: 猪八戒开放平台 (ZOP) router API: every call is GET https://openapi.zbj.com/router with appKey, accessToken, method, v=1.0, format=json, a 13-digit timestamp and sign (SHA1 over secret + params sorted by name + secret, 签名算法). Failures answer {errorToken, code, message, solution}. Applications are subject to platform approval (应用运营规则).

me.note: zbj.user.getUserBaseInfo (openid): nickname, userName, avatarPath, openid of the authorised account.

get_posting.note: zbj.task.getDetailById (taskId): the 需求 with title, content, mode (1 比稿, 2 招标, 3 众包), employer nickname, amount (budget, CNY), hostedAmount, createTime (epoch seconds), remainTime (seconds), worksAvailableNum, category ids, milestones and attachments (in raw).

not_offered.search_postings: The 需求API group has a single method, zbj.task.getDetailById ('通过需求ID查询需求详情', https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex); there is no call that searches or lists open demands.
not_offered.submit_bid: No bid/proposal call is documented: the 交易API methods cover work already joined (queryParticipatedPieceWorks, bidWork = '提交悬赏/众包稿件' manuscript upload, contracts, acceptance), not quoting an amount on a demand (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex).
not_offered.withdraw_bid: zbj.trade.sellerGiveUp ('服务商投标后放弃需求', https://open.zbj.com/api/apiDetailIndex?methodId=95&groupId=4) takes openid + taskId + a required optionId from zbj.trade.giveUpReasonOps; there is no bid id and the vocabulary has no reason option.
not_offered.bid_status: No bid ids are issued; outcomes are split across zbj.trade.getSigningOutcome / getWorkInfo per trade type (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex).
not_offered.list_messages: The IM group only has zbj.msg.getLastInstant ('获取最近即时消息信息', https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex); there is no thread message list.
not_offered.send_message: No message-sending method is documented in the IM group (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex).
not_offered.credits: No balance or bid-credit method is documented (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex).

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token, openid; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
